findings.subject: Native semantics do not require global historical artifact presence
findings.detail: In installed DEVAI 2.7.0, resolveSensorReadingInstance (release-host.js:214661-214692) iterates only files physically present in the store directory. It throws SENSE_INSTANCE_CHAIN_DIGEST_MISMATCH only when no chain binding for that path matches the file's digest (`bindings.some`). The scorecard custody loader (203606-203612), readingReceipts (196674-196684) and the record path (chainedBindings, 247866) use the same any-binding semantics. Absent historical files are never iterated. The seq-325 path passes because the seq-361 binding matches. D-5 therefore needs no native guard exception, rebuild or re-registration. The fresh epoch's lineage depends only on X-bound bindings, since candidates are filtered to binding.head === HEAD.

findings.subject: D-5 matches the original EC2 intent
findings.detail: review1.json EC2 text reads 'Committing old74 must include every reading file the chain refers to … Do not rewrite or reorder the chain'. Its purpose was to ensure the old74 commit has complete custody for what it appends. The literal 'every … in the committed chain' wording could not have been met even at the baseline, which already had 13 gaps. D-5 proves complete custody of the new records, preservation of every available historical byte, and no new loss, and it discloses the exact 13 limitations. That is the strongest truthful form of EC2. It neither restores nor substitutes anything. The prior PASS must still not be quoted as a global historical-custody PASS.

findings.subject: round seal resolves D-3 globally in law/register
findings.detail: assertClosePreconditions (release-host.js ~181363) calls decisionExists for both declared_by and closed_by. decisionExists accepts only law/adr/D-3.md, law/register/D-3.md, or a line matching /^###\s+D-3\b/m in law/register/DECISIONS.md. That register currently has only `### D-1` and `### D-2` top-level headings, plus 'Anexo de R-…' headings that do not match. Without an accurate additive top-level `### D-3` heading (and an R-0043 annex), seal fails with ROUND_ARCHIVE_DECISION_MISSING:D-3. The proposal already names this step. It is a real source prerequisite, not optional. The wording must be generic and accurate (a later closing judgment where D-2 was already used), must not repurpose D-2, and must not grant authority beyond each round's own AUTHORIZATION/annex. `round close` does not check this; only seal does.
